name: GPU Mesh Voxelization via AABB-Triangle Intersection
aliases: GPU Mesh Voxelization via Triangle-AABB Intersection
definition: A GPU-based method to convert a triangle mesh into a set of voxel points by dispatching one compute thread per grid cell and testing each cell's Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) against all mesh triangles.
summary: A GPU brute-force voxelization method using compute shaders to test each voxel's AABB against all mesh triangles, differing from rasterization and projection approaches.
